# Introduction

The `NumericalSummaryPackage` provides a simple function, `numSummary()`, to summarize numeric data.

# Example Usage

```{r}
library(NumericalSummaryPackage)

my_numbers <- c(1, 5, 3, 9, 2)
summary_obj <- numSummary(my_numbers)
summary_obj
